text: Pints are £5 each. You buy three and pay with a £20 note. How much change?
Which is more: half a dozen, or a quarter of twenty?
why: Half a dozen is 6; a quarter of twenty is 5.

text: A bus fare is £2.50 each way. What do two people pay for a return trip?
why: £5 return each, and two of them make £10.

text: Five friends each buy a round of five drinks at £4 a drink. What do they spend altogether?
You leave a 15% tip on a £40 meal. How much is the tip?
A bottle of wine fills six glasses. Four people want three glasses each. How many bottles?
A car does 50 miles to the gallon and petrol costs £7 a gallon. What does a 200-mile trip cost in fuel?
Which month of the year has the longest name?
why: Nine letters; November, December and February have eight.
